help:
Command		Description
help		Display this help screen
destroy		Kill all running applications
launch		Launch an app by Title ID
kill		Kill an app by Title ID
nosleep		Control automatic suspend prevention
press		Press or position a synthetic input
reboot		Reboot the console
release		Release a synthetic input
screen		Turn the screen on or off
version		Display the Vita Companion version
wait		Wait for a duration such as 100ms or 3s
